instructions.when: Changing authentication or authorization behavior or its security requirements.
instructions.instruction: Read docs/security/formal-auth-verification.md and spec/formal/proof-registry.json; record each affected requirement, implementation, formal status, and evidence, and run every suite mapped to the changed implementation.
instructions.verification: Record the actual proof, conformance, drift, and other applicable security-check results.
instructions.boundary: A proof of a model and finite conformance tests do not prove the whole implementation; leave uncovered properties explicitly unproved.
